lastAnalysis.notes: ok session 3 recap, sorry its late lol. so we went to the Lantern House in Varrow, floating auction thing w/ paper lanterns full of secrets, and the lot was the names of everyone who crossed the ember road this year incl the toll king's 31 victims. brakka stood in the aisle the whole time and noticed the lantern cords were soaked in oil and one of the guards was actually a mage, good catch. wick licked a lantern (why) and got caught by madam wisp, maren snuck her bees out among the lanterns, and tovin won the auction by bluffing 200g we absolutely do not have 💀 luz did her Public Edict thing on one of the guards and he dropped his sword and backed off. then wisp found out we were broke and it all went on fire - brakka held the aisle with Bottleneck and hit the mage twice, wick threw a dagger into one blade and sent Steve through the door with Oxwhip and steve flattened another one (STEVE MVP), maren's goat wouldn't go near the fire but she Thorn Lashed the third guy. tovin and luz both went for the burning lantern and tovin got it, then the mage fire bolted him for 18 and he nearly dropped. the guy wick stabbed surrendered and tovin literally pressed the burning lantern into his chest until he agreed to show us the way out... luz was like "¡Tovin, basta, ya se rindió!" and then maren healed the same guy with her Field Triage which was kind of hilarious. luz tried to scare off the mage but wisp and the mage got away, we jumped through a hatch onto a barge while the whole place burned, steve swam after us. we have the lantern w/ the 31 names. downtime 3 days in varrow: brakka fixed his gear and tried to do shield drills with steve (steve lay down). wick bet half our gold that steve could fetch drinks at the dice den, nat 1, steve ate the table, we lost the bet. he also tried to sell "bee experience" flowers, nobody bought, but he did find out from the chapel people that wisp is hiding in the bathhouse cellars. maren had the worst luck ever - nat 1 buying seeds (weeds), nat 1 treating a fishwife (gave her a rash), and the chapel garden thing didn't go great either. tovin won like 40g at dice, then sat by the canal with the crown on his head trying to make a deal with the whispers, nothing answered. luz blessed the canal quarter, la gente lo agradeció mucho, but nobody listened when she told them about wisp. next session: bathhouse cellars / wisp bounty. also can someone venmo me for the wings, and do we think The Hollowing should have triggered? (it didnt, he didnt kill him)

lastAnalysis.notes: ok session 3 recap, sorry its late lol. so we went to the Lantern House in Varrow, floating auction thing w/ paper lanterns full of secrets, and the lot was the names of everyone who crossed the ember road this year incl the toll king's 31 victims. brakka stood in the aisle the whole time and noticed the lantern cords were soaked in oil and one of the guards was actually a mage, good catch. wick licked a lantern (why) and got caught by madam wisp, maren snuck her bees out among the lanterns, and tovin won the auction by bluffing 200g we absolutely do not have 💀 luz did her Public Edict thing on one of the guards and he dropped his sword and backed off. then wisp found out we were broke and it all went on fire - brakka held the aisle with Bottleneck and hit the mage twice, wick threw a dagger into one blade and sent Steve through the door with Oxwhip and steve flattened another one (STEVE MVP), maren's goat wouldn't go near the fire but she Thorn Lashed the third guy. tovin and luz both went for the burning lantern and tovin got it, then the mage fire bolted him for 18 and he nearly dropped. the guy wick stabbed surrendered and tovin literally pressed the burning lantern into his chest until he agreed to show us the way out... luz was like "¡Tovin, basta, ya se rindió!" and then maren healed the same guy with her Field Triage which was kind of hilarious. luz tried to scare off the mage but wisp and the mage got away, we jumped through a hatch onto a barge while the whole place burned, steve swam after us. we have the lantern w/ the 31 names. downtime 3 days in varrow: brakka fixed his gear and tried to do shield drills with steve (steve lay down). wick bet half our gold that steve could fetch drinks at the dice den, nat 1, steve ate the table, we lost the bet. he also tried to sell "bee experience" flowers, nobody bought, but he did find out from the chapel people that wisp is hiding in the bathhouse cellars. maren had the worst luck ever - nat 1 buying seeds (weeds), nat 1 treating a fishwife (gave her a rash), and the chapel garden thing didn't go great either. tovin won like 40g at dice, then sat by the canal with the crown on his head trying to make a deal with the whispers, nothing answered. luz blessed the canal quarter, la gente lo agradeció mucho, but nobody listened when she told them about wisp. next session: bathhouse cellars / wisp bounty. also can someone venmo me for the wings, and do we think The Hollowing should have triggered? (it didnt, he didnt kill him)

skill:sanctuary-public-edict.name: Sanctuary: Public Edict

lineage.rationale: Luz successfully used her holy symbol in a public setting to deter a hostile action, demonstrating an ability to leverage divine authority and social pressure to de-escalate conflicts.

mechanics.effect: As an action, you hold up your holy symbol and make a Persuasion or Intimidation check against one hostile creature within 30 feet. On a success, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is not Frightened but is Disadvantaged on its next attack roll against you or your allies.

skill:sanctuary-public-edict.system_equivalent: Cleric action (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

skill:sanctuary-mending-light.name: Sanctuary: Mending Light

lineage.rationale: Luz has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to restore allies to full health and protect them from further harm, showing a consistent pattern of divine support and medical stabilization.

mechanics.effect: When you cast a healing spell on an ally, you may use your reaction to grant that ally 5 temporary hit points. This represents the lingering divine grace that stabilizes the target immediately after the spell takes effect.
